output_text:
name: php-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a complete, production-ready PHP MCP server with the official PHP SDK, tools, resources, prompts, and tests.

Ask the user for: project name, server description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, whether to include resources/prompts, and PHP version (8.2+ required). Then generate the complete project.

Composer: `"name": "your-org/{project-name}"`, `"description": "{Server description}"`, `"optimize-autoloader": true`, `"preferred-install": "dist"`, `"sort-packages": true`.

Use PHP 8.2 or higher. Include `server.php`, `src/Tools`, `src/Resources`, `src/Prompts`, and `tests`. Use `declare(strict_types=1);` in all PHP files; PSR-12; PHPDoc for all methods; `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, and `#[Schema]` validation attributes; clear, specific exceptions; PHPUnit tests for all tools; and PSR-16 discovery caching in production.

Server setup: `require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';`; use `Mcp\Server`, `Mcp\Server\Transport\StdioTransport`, `Symfony\Component\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter`, and `Symfony\Component\Cache\Psr16Cache`. Configure `new Psr16Cache(new FilesystemAdapter('mcp-discovery', 3600, __DIR__ . '/cache'))`, server info `{Project Name}`, version `1.0.0`, discovery excluding `vendor`, `tests`, `cache`; run with `new StdioTransport()` when using stdio. Support requested HTTP/both transports.

Provide example tools: greeting (`greet(string $name): string` → `"Hello, {$name}!"`); arithmetic with add/subtract/multiply/divide, throwing `InvalidArgumentException('Division by zero')` or `InvalidArgumentException('Invalid operation')`; simple action (`"Processed: {$input}"`); email validation via `filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false`; `Status` enum (`ACTIVE = 'active'`, `INACTIVE = 'inactive'`) and status setter returning id/status; settings returning `['key' => 'value']`; user lookup throwing `RuntimeException('User not found')`.

Optional resources: `config://app/settings` (`app_config`, `application/json`); template `data://{category}/{id}` (`data_resource`, `application/json`), returning sample category/id data. Optional prompts: code review (general focus default; expert reviewer content and formatted code) and documentation (`detailed` default).

Tests should cover greeting and calculation add/divide, division by zero, and invalid operation. PHPUnit config bootstraps `vendor/autoload.php` and tests `tests` and `src`.

Run server: `php server.php`
Server args: `"args": ["/absolute/path/to/server.php"]`
Run tests: `vendor/bin/phpunit`
Test with MCP Inspector:
`npx <REDACTED_USER>/inspector php server.php`
